reason: B is more directly grounded in automotive exhaust chemistry: a nanometric ceria overcoat can plausibly provide oxygen-storage/redox functionality and inhibit sintering without increasing PGM loading, with light-off and aging tests against an untreated control. A largely transplants an already demonstrated N-doped Pt/HEA fuel-cell ORR design into a chemically different exhaust regime, without establishing that M–N bonds survive oxidizing thermal aging or mitigate H2O/NO inhibition.
